governing_grammar: docs/architecture/decision-log.md ADR-0125 'Captured ports and enforced multi-run stages' (the only document spelling, valid only as the complete value of one declared node input).

descriptor.outer: a node input value is the exact built-in dict {"$captured_artifact": <descriptor>}; no other key beside "$captured_artifact" on that outer object

types.document_sha256: exact lowercase 64-hex SHA-256, not the 64-zero placeholder, not 'self'
types.purpose: non-empty str (parser intentionally stricter than the broker route's equality-only purpose; no closed purpose set exists in ADR-0125)

descriptor.cardinality: exactly six keys; no missing, extra, duplicate, or null member; the descriptor VALUE is a built-in dict (not str/number/list/bool)
descriptor.no_nesting: the descriptor value contains only those six scalar strings; no nested $captured_artifact, no list/map value, no $node.output / $prev / $captured_artifact reference inside any scalar
descriptor.derived_not_spelled: consumer_document_sha256, consumer_node, consumer_input are parser-derived (ConsumerCapturedPort) and must NOT be spelled inside the descriptor

positive_grammar.only_legal_location: the complete value of one declared node input (top-level entry of NodeSpec.inputs); the outer object has exactly one key, "$captured_artifact".

changed_approach.principle: A single full-document recursive positional sweep replaces section enumeration. No section is asserted 'closed'; the design is robust to any present or future open dict.
changed_approach.detection_primitive: _contains_captured_ref(obj): True iff obj is a built-in dict containing the key "$captured_artifact", or recursively True in any dict value or list/tuple item (parallel to _contains_prev_ref, document.py:292-300). This is the sole detection primitive.
changed_approach.shape_helper: _validate_captured_descriptor(inner): enforces the exact six-key shape and value types; returns/raises. Used by NodeSpec to recognize a legal input descriptor, and by the walker to diagnose every other occurrence.
changed_approach.walker: In PipelineDocument.from_obj (the shared parse entry for load_document and every public parse path), walk the complete raw document object once and collect every "$captured_artifact" occurrence with its position.
changed_approach.positional_legality: An occurrence is legal ONLY when the dict carrying "$captured_artifact" is the exact complete value (sole key) of a pipeline.<node>.inputs.<port> or foreach.pipeline.<template>.inputs.<port> entry AND the document declares an execution_backtest block. Every other occurrence refuses: params, tracking.sinks[].params, stages (inputs/params), outputs, env, schedule, clock, splits, walkforward, a $prev default, artifact, nested lists/maps, or any other depth.
changed_approach.node_level_role: NodeSpec.from_obj only SHAPE-validates (accepts) a legal descriptor shape in inputs; it has no document context. Legality (execution_backtest required, and the positional sweep) is enforced solely by PipelineDocument.from_obj/__post_init__.
changed_approach.execution_gate: the existing planner.refuse_execution_backtest and __main__.load_and_preflight_public_document continue to refuse execution documents before planning/provider/broker/node import; the descriptor grammar opens no ordinary-pipeline execution route.

negative_families.scope_note: Packet 5 freezes grammar and location only. It introduces NO deep-copy/freeze of the parsed descriptor and no new mutable alias beyond the parser's pre-existing shallow-copy behavior (_copy_mapping_or_raw is dict(value) for all inputs/params). Descriptor mutation-after-parse and freeze protection are re-validated by the broker route (trust.py freeze_consumer_document + derive_consumer_port re-hash, Packet 4) and are swept in Packet 6 equality/substitution; they are out of Packet 5 scope.

entry_points_swept: dskit.pipeline.__main__ cmd_plan / cmd_run / cmd_validate / cmd_staged / cmd_walkforward / cmd_nodemap

context_rule.principle: A captured-artifact descriptor is recognized and shape-validated at the node level; it is a legal node input ONLY in an execution_backtest document. An ordinary (non-execution) document containing a $captured_artifact descriptor refuses at PipelineDocument level with a clear diagnostic; ordinary documents with no descriptor remain byte-identical in canonical JSON, hash, plan hash, and run identity.
context_rule.execution_gate: the existing planner.refuse_execution_backtest and __main__.load_and_preflight_public_document continue to refuse execution documents before planning/provider/broker/node import; the descriptor grammar does not open an ordinary-pipeline execution route.

forbidden_effects: planning or stage compilation before grammar refusal
treating a descriptor-shaped dict as capture authority in JSON
